subject: 2nd Grade Winter Performance - December 18 at 6:00 PM
text_body:
Dear 2nd Grade Families,

Our 2nd graders have been working hard in music class and are excited to present their Winter Performance! We would love for you to join us for this special evening.

PERFORMANCE DETAILS:
Date: Thursday, December 18, 2026
Time: 6:00 PM (students arrive at 5:30 PM)
Location: Lincoln Elementary Auditorium

DRESS CODE FOR STUDENTS:
- White collared shirt or blouse
- Dark pants or dark skirt
- Please no sneakers - dress shoes if possible
- Holiday accessories (festive ties, hair bows, etc.) are welcome but not required

The performance will feature a variety of winter and holiday songs, including some songs with classroom instruments. The show will last approximately 35-40 minutes, followed by a brief reception with cookies and hot cocoa in the cafeteria.

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Please have your child in the music room by 5:30 PM so we can line up and do a quick warm-up
- The auditorium doors will open for seating at 5:45 PM
- Photography and video are welcome during the performance
- Please keep younger siblings seated during the show

If your child will not be able to attend, please let me know by Monday, December 15 so we can adjust our arrangements.

We can't wait to share our music with you!

Ms. Angela Rivera
Music Teacher
Lincoln Elementary School
